record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: mask-form switch on shield depletion (OnShieldDepletedEffect) plus a passive-keyed branch inside the IVY_CUDGEL ability
record.summary: Passive.OGERPON_TEAL has one PassiveEffects entry, an OnShieldDepletedEffect created by ogerponMaskDropEffect; the rest of its behaviour is a passive-keyed branch of the IVY_CUDGEL ability (the Passive is also referenced in the ability file and the item-drop code). Units OGERPON_TEAL and OGERPON_TEAL_MASK are both 3 stars, maxPP 100, range 1, GRASS + FLORA, same stats; the MASK form holds the TEAL_MASK item (declared SHIELD 100 and SPEED 30). When the masked unit's shield is depleted the entity is renamed to OGERPON_TEAL and the mask item is removed from the entity. On every IVY_CUDGEL cast (both forms) the target takes the ability hit (100 at 3 stars, requested special damage), then the caster counts enemy occupants in its adjacent cells and calls addAttack(6 x count, caster, apBoost 1, crit): requested +6 ATK per adjacent enemy, scaled by (1 + AP/100) and by critPower on a crit, rounded, then passed through Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, if held) and Twist Band (only flips negative values, so not relevant to this positive request); the applied change is therefore not simply 6 x count. The ATK gain is a temporary fight stat (permanent flag not set). The branch is skipped if the target hit is irrelevant: the buff happens regardless of whether the main hit was blocked by protect. Requested amounts are labelled; no gameplay claims.
triggers: OnShieldDepletedEffect: the shield reaches 0 after a hit or a negative addShield
IVY_CUDGEL cast: branch keyed on pokemon.passive

effects.declaredRaw: TEAL_MASK declares SHIELD 100 and SPEED 30; when the shield is depleted the MASK form reverts to OGERPON_TEAL
effects.scaling: none; shield requested = 100 via addShield(100, self, 0, false); speed requested = 30 via addSpeed(30, self, 0, false)
effects.resolution: requested shield 100; applied by addShield: enraged halves a positive shield, Math.round. SPEED 30 goes through addSpeed (Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helpers, then clamp 0..MAX_SPEED; section I of core-mechanics.md). On depletion the effect sets entity name/index to OGERPON_TEAL and removes the mask item from the entity; the stat bonuses already applied (including the +30 speed) are not reversed in the code read

effects.declaredRaw: IVY_CUDGEL hit on the target: 100 at 3 stars (table 50 / 75 / 100 / 200)
effects.scaling: handleSpecialDamage default apBoost; crit flag from the cast
effects.resolution: requested 100 (3 stars); blocked on a protected / skydiving / magic-bouncing target; otherwise reduced by SPE_DEF with the min-1 rule

effects.declaredRaw: +6 ATK per enemy in the adjacent cells, to the caster
effects.scaling: addAttack(6 x n, caster, apBoost 1, crit): requested value x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit, Math.round, so AP scales it (caster = receiver)
effects.resolution: requested 6 x n (n = enemy occupants among the adjacent cells; includesCenter true adds only the caster own cell, which is same team and filtered out). Applied change = Math.round(requested x AP factor x crit factor), then Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down if the caster holds it; Twist Band cannot change a positive value; atk = max(1, atk + applied). n is counted after the main hit (a target killed by the hit may already be removed from its cell - not traced). Stacks on every cast; fight-only

conditions: Mask-drop switch only when the current name is the MASK form and the mask item is held.
The IVY_CUDGEL branch is keyed on pokemon.passive, so both forms behave alike.
Adjacent count uses the 3x3 block around the caster with the centre included; the centre is the caster so it never counts (team check).
record.resetBehaviour: The mask-drop switch happens once (the mask item is removed). The ATK gain is added on each IVY_CUDGEL cast and never removed in the code read; fight stats are rebuilt for the next fight.

evidence.note: OnShieldDepletedEffect (origin = the mask item): when the unit's name is the MASK form and it holds the mask, its entity name/index are switched to the unmasked form and the mask item is removed from the entity
called when a hit's shield part is >= the remaining shield
also called when a negative addShield brings the shield to 0 or below
applied after taking a hit that removed all the remaining shield
OnItemDroppedEffect: dropping a mask item on an Ogerpon swaps any current mask, adds the new mask and transforms into the matching MASK form (refused if 3 items are held and no mask to replace)
declared item SHIELD stat becomes addShield(value, self, 0, false) when the entity is created (see core-mechanics.md section I)
addShield: no AP scaling at apBoost 0, crit factor only if crit, enraged halves positive shield, then Math.round
a protected unit takes no damage (death false, takenDamage 0)
handleSpecialDamage on a protected, skydiving or magic-bouncing target is blocked (spellBlockedCount) instead of damaging
main hit on the target for every Ogerpon form (50 / 75 / 100 / 200 by stars; all four units here are 3 stars -> 100), special damage via handleSpecialDamage
getAdjacentCells(x, y, false) returns the up to 8 surrounding cells without the centre; the ability passes false for the passive branches
OGERPON_TEAL: 3 stars, maxPP 100, range 1, GRASS + FLORA, skill IVY_CUDGEL
OGERPON_TEAL_MASK: same stats, GRASS + FLORA, onAcquired passes TEAL_MASK
only entry: ogerponMaskDropEffect(TEAL_MASK, OGERPON_TEAL_MASK -> OGERPON_TEAL)
declared mask bonuses: SHIELD 100 and SPEED 30
TEAL branch: counts enemy occupants in the 3x3 block (centre included but it is the caster itself, same team) and gives the caster +6 ATK per enemy, apBoost 1, crit passed
addAttack: Math.round of value x (1 + apBoost x caster AP / 100) x critPower if crit, then Big Eater Belt and Twist Band helpers, then atk = max(1, atk + value); temporary unless permanent
addSpeed (used by the mask SPEED 30 through applyStat with apBoost 0): helpers first, MELMETAL redirect to addAttack, otherwise speed clamped to 0..MAX_SPEED
plain functions: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down on positive changes; Twist Band flips negative changes from enemies/environment
declared item SPEED stat becomes addSpeed(value, self, 0, false)
